record.label: Bounds on expected parallel query rounds for large N
record.description: For each fixed $(m,k)$, the authors certify a rational $R(m,k)$ such that $\overline{D}_{n,m,k}\le R(m,k)D_{\mathrm{std}}(2^n,m,k)$ for all sufficiently large $n$. The average $\overline{D}_{n,m,k}$ is uniform over marked sets of size $k$.
